description: This source file defines a class `CBFRecord` which represents a CloudZero Billing Format (CBF) record structure tailored for integration with LiteLLM usage data. It uses a dictionary-based approach to accommodate special character-containing field names and details the expected fields related to CloudZero billing and resource information.

classes.name: CBFRecord
classes.description: A dictionary-based class representing a CloudZero Billing Format (CBF) record, accommodating special characters in field names to store usage and billing data for CloudZero integration.
